questions.question: When Vidura asked Uddhava to speak on the messages of Lord Krsna, why was Uddhava unable to answer immediately?

options.text: Due to excessive anxiety at the remembrance of the Lord
Because he did not know the answer
Because he was angry with Vidura
Because he was tired from traveling

questions.explanation: "Uddhava was unable to answer immediately due to excessive anxiety at the remembrance of the Lord." (SB 3.2.1)

questions.question: At what age was Uddhava so absorbed in the service of Lord Krsna that he did not wish to take his morning breakfast when called by his mother?
questions.explanation: "He was one who even in his childhood, at the age of five years, was so absorbed in the service of Lord Krsna that when he was called by his mother for morning breakfast, he did not wish to have it." (SB 3.2.2)

questions.question: What did Vidura observe Uddhava trying to wipe away from his eyes, signifying total ecstasy?

options.text: Tears of separation from the Lord
Tears of joy at meeting Vidura

questions.explanation: "Uddhava had all the transcendental bodily changes due to total ecstasy, and he was trying to wipe away tears of separation from his eyes." (SB 3.2.5)

questions.question: How did Uddhava describe Lord Krsna's disappearance, calling Him the sun of the world?

options.text: He has gone to the forest
The sun of the world, Lord Krsna, has set

questions.explanation: "My dear Vidura, the sun of the world, Lord Krsna, has set, and our house has now been swallowed by the great snake of time." (SB 3.2.7)

questions.question: To what did Uddhava compare the Yadu dynasty's failure to identify Lord Hari as the Personality of Godhead?

options.text: A blind man missing the path
A fish that could not identify the moon
A bird that cannot see the sky
A child who cannot recognize fire

questions.explanation: "They could not identify Lord Hari as the Personality of Godhead, any more than the fish could identify the moon." (SB 3.2.8)

questions.question: By which internal potency did the Lord appear in the mortal world in His eternal form?
questions.explanation: "The Lord appeared in the mortal world by His internal potency, yoga-maya." (SB 3.2.12)

questions.question: When Krsna left the damsels of Vraja, what happened to them?

options.text: They sat down with stunned intelligence and could not finish their household duties

questions.explanation: "They used to follow Him with their eyes, and thus they sat down with stunned intelligence and could not finish their household duties." (SB 3.2.14)

questions.question: When Krsna went away from His father's protection to Vraja, why did He live there incognito?

options.text: Out of fear of the enemy

questions.explanation: "How He went away from His father's protection to Vraja and lived there incognito out of fear of the enemy." (SB 3.2.16)

questions.question: From whom did Lord Krsna beg pardon for His inability to serve their feet, due to being away from home out of fear of Kamsa?
questions.explanation: "Lord Krsna begged pardon from His parents for Their inability to serve their feet, due to being away from home because of great fear of Kamsa." (SB 3.2.17)

questions.question: Who, the King of Cedi, achieved success in yoga practice although he hated Lord Krsna?
questions.explanation: "You have personally seen how the King of Cedi [Sisupala] achieved success in yoga practice, although he hated Lord Krsna." (SB 3.2.19)

questions.question: How did the fighters on the Battlefield of Kuruksetra who saw Krsna's lotuslike face achieve the abode of the Lord?

options.text: Purified by the onslaught of Arjuna's arrows

questions.explanation: "Others who were fighters on the Battlefield of Kuruksetra were purified by the onslaught of Arjuna's arrows." (SB 3.2.20)

questions.question: What pained Uddhava to remember about how Krsna behaved before King Ugrasena?

options.text: That He used to stand and submit explanations before him while Ugrasena sat on the throne
That He was rebuked by Ugrasena

questions.explanation: "He used to stand before King Ugrasena, who was sitting on the royal throne, and used to submit explanations before him." (SB 3.2.22)

questions.question: To whom did Lord Krsna grant the position of mother although she prepared deadly poison to be sucked from her breast?
questions.explanation: "He who granted the position of mother to a she-demon [Putana] although she was unfaithful and she prepared deadly poison to be sucked from her breast." (SB 3.2.23)

questions.question: In whose womb was Lord Krsna begotten by Vasudeva, in the prison of the King of Bhoja?
questions.explanation: "Lord Sri Krsna... was begotten by Vasudeva in the womb of his wife Devaki in the prison of the King of Bhoja." (SB 3.2.25)

questions.question: For how many years did Krsna live in the cow pastures of Maharaja Nanda like a covered flame with His elder brother Baladeva?
questions.explanation: "There He lived for eleven years like a covered flame with His elder brother, Baladeva." (SB 3.2.26)

questions.question: Who engaged the great wizards able to assume any form to kill Krsna?
questions.explanation: "The great wizards who were able to assume any form were engaged by the King of Bhoja, Kamsa, to kill Krsna." (SB 3.2.30)

questions.question: Which chief of the reptiles poisoned a certain portion of the Yamuna, distressing the inhabitants of Vrndavana?
questions.explanation: "A certain portion of the Yamuna was poisoned by the chief of the reptiles [Kaliya]." (SB 3.2.31)

questions.question: Whom did Krsna want to give a lesson by advising His father to perform worship of the cows and pasturing land?
questions.explanation: "Also He wanted to give a lesson to Indra, the King of heaven." (SB 3.2.32)

questions.question: With what did the compassionate Lord Krsna save the inhabitants of Vraja when Indra poured water incessantly?

options.text: His pastime umbrella, the Govardhana Hill

questions.explanation: "The compassionate Lord Krsna saved them from danger with His pastime umbrella, the Govardhana Hill." (SB 3.2.33)

questions.question: In which season did the Lord enjoy as the central beauty of the assembly of women, attracting them with His pleasing songs?

options.text: The third season of the year, an autumn night brightened by moonshine

questions.explanation: "In the third season of the year, the Lord enjoyed as the central beauty of the assembly of women by attracting them with His pleasing songs in an autumn night brightened by moonshine." (SB 3.2.34)

questions.question: At the age of ______ years Uddhava was absorbed in the service of Lord Krishna.
When Vidura asked about the welfare of Lord Krishna and His family and devotees, Vidura noticed that Uddhava______.

options.text: Eyes were in tears due to separation from the Lord
Had assimilated extensive love for the Lord

questions.question: Uddhava said it pained him to see Krishna______.

options.text: Standing before King Ugrasena and giving explanations to the king
Begging pardon from His parents for His inability to serve them
In His childhood living incognito from fear of Kamsa

questions.question: Uddhava narrated the pastime of ______ to Vidura.

options.text: Lord Krishna playing at the banks of Yamuna with His cowherd friends and calves
Killing of various asuras sent by Kamsa
Teaching lessons to Indra and Kaliya

questions.question: The last pastime of Lord Sri Krishna in Vrindavan explained by Uddhava to Vidura was______.
